raw_segments.text: Antony, tease well-blown, lads. This morning, like the spirit of a youth that means to be
of note, begins betimes. So, so? Come, give me that, this way, well said. Fair thee well,
dame. Whate'er becomes of me, this is a soldier's kiss. Kisses her. Rebucable and worthy shameful
check it were, to stand on more mechanic compliment. I'll leave thee now like a man of steel. You
that will fight, follow me close, I'll bring you taut. Ado.
